p: Brady praised Gore's first two weeks and was glad to get him back, which suggests a share of the backfield work but no clear change in role.
Frank obviously did an outstanding job the first two weeks
Gore played in critical situations (blocking, a big catch) with Ty Johnson unavailable and has the coach's confidence.
Gore has earned trust in a depth role, but this is more a blocking/depth signal than a fantasy-relevant workload.
Frank is a guy that just always does the things right.
